name: KeyCRM
description: KeyCRM (Ukraine) for online shops and sales teams: read orders, buyers, products, variants and stock, sales pipelines and their cards, order statuses and sources, and create orders through the KeyCRM OpenAPI.
instructions:
KeyCRM is a Ukrainian CRM for online shops. This adapter reads orders, buyers, the product catalogue with stock, and sales pipelines, and can create an order.

**Getting credentials**
1. In KeyCRM open Settings → General (Налаштування → Основні) and find the API key field.
2. Click Generate API key (Згенерувати API ключ) if none exists yet, copy it and paste it into `KEYCRM_API_KEY`. Only the CRM owner can refresh the key; refreshing it stops the old key at once in every integration.

**Workflow**: `keycrm_list_order_statuses` and `keycrm_list_order_sources` return the ids the order filters need. `keycrm_list_orders` lists orders, `keycrm_get_order` returns one with its buyer, products, payments and shipping. Find customers with `keycrm_list_buyers` (by phone or email). For stock use `keycrm_list_offers` (variants with quantity and reserve) or `keycrm_list_stocks` (per warehouse with details=true). Pipelines (Воронки) hold leads as cards: `keycrm_list_pipelines`, `keycrm_list_pipeline_statuses`, `keycrm_list_pipeline_cards`.

**Formats and gotchas**: ids are integers. All times are UTC (GMT+0). Date-range filters take `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. Several values for one filter are comma-separated, e.g. `status_id` = `1,4`. Without `include` an order or card comes back without its buyer, products or status; the tools send useful defaults. If pipelines are switched off in the CRM settings, pipeline tools answer 400 Leads are not enabled. Phone numbers work best in international format with `+`.

**Writes**: `keycrm_create_order` creates a real order (and a new buyer if the contact is new). Show the user the source, buyer and products and wait for confirmation; never retry a successful call.

**Pagination and rate limits**: list tools take `page` (from 1) and `limit` (max 50, default 50 here). The body carries `total`, `current_page` and `next_page_url`: call again with `page` + 1 until `next_page_url` is null. KeyCRM allows 20 requests per minute per API key, so prefer filters over paging through everything; on HTTP 429 wait a minute.

**Cloud reachability**: `openapi.keycrm.app` is a public HTTPS API, reachable from AnythingMCP Cloud and from self-hosted installs.

KEYCRM_API_KEY.label: API key
KEYCRM_API_KEY.help: In KeyCRM: Settings → General (Налаштування → Основні), API key field. Paste only the key.
KEYCRM_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste only the key, without spaces or the word Bearer.

verifyHints.401: KeyCRM refused the API key. Copy it again from Settings → General; if the owner refreshed it, the old key no longer works.
verifyHints.rate_limited: KeyCRM allows 20 requests per minute per API key. Wait a minute and try again.

tools.name: keycrm_list_orders
tools.description: List KeyCRM orders, newest first by default, filtered by status, source, buyer phone or email, payment status or created/updated/shipping date range. Page with page + 1 until next_page_url is null.

status_id.description: Order status id(s) from keycrm_list_order_statuses, comma-separated, e.g. 1,4.

source_id.description: Order source id(s) from keycrm_list_order_sources, comma-separated.

source_uuid.description: Order number in the source system (shop or marketplace).

buyer_phone.description: Buyer phone(s), comma-separated, international format, e.g. +380671234567.

created_between.description: Created in this UTC range: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

updated_between.description: Updated in this UTC range, same format as created_between.

shipping_between.description: Shipping date in this UTC range, same format as created_between.

has_tracking_code.description: true for orders with a tracking number, false for orders without.

include.description: Comma-separated relations to add: buyer, products.offer, manager, tags, status, marketing, payments, shipping.lastHistory, shipping.deliveryService, expenses, custom_fields, assigned. Default buyer,status.

sort.description: id for oldest first, -id for newest first. Default -id.

limit.description: Orders per page, up to 50. Default 50.

tools.name: keycrm_get_order
tools.description: Get one KeyCRM order by id with its buyer, products and variants, status, payments, shipping and manager.

include.description: Comma-separated relations to add: buyer, products.offer, manager, tags, status, marketing, payments, shipping.lastHistory, shipping.deliveryService, expenses, custom_fields, assigned.

tools.name: keycrm_list_order_statuses
tools.description: List the active KeyCRM order statuses with their ids and names (e.g. New, Confirmed, Shipped). Use the ids to filter keycrm_list_orders.

limit.description: Statuses per page, up to 50. Default 50.

tools.name: keycrm_list_order_sources
tools.description: List KeyCRM order sources (shops, marketplaces, manual entry) with their ids. keycrm_create_order needs a source_id from here.

limit.description: Sources per page, up to 50. Default 50.

tools.name: keycrm_list_buyers
tools.description: List or find KeyCRM buyers (customers) by id, phone, email or created/updated date range. Page with page + 1 until next_page_url is null.

created_between.description: Created in this UTC range: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

updated_between.description: Updated in this UTC range, same format as created_between.

include.description: Comma-separated relations to add: manager, shipping, company, loyalty, custom_fields.

limit.description: Buyers per page, up to 50. Default 50.

tools.name: keycrm_get_buyer
tools.description: Get one KeyCRM buyer by id with phones, emails, manager, company, shipping addresses and loyalty totals (discount, purchase sums).

buyer_id.description: Buyer id from keycrm_list_buyers or an order's buyer.

include.description: Comma-separated relations to add: manager, shipping, company, loyalty, custom_fields.

tools.name: keycrm_list_products
tools.description: List products in the KeyCRM catalogue, optionally by product id, category id or archive state. Variants and their stock come from keycrm_list_offers.

is_archived.description: true for archived products only, false for active ones.

include.description: custom_fields to add custom field values.

limit.description: Products per page, up to 50. Default 50.

tools.name: keycrm_list_offers
tools.description: List product variants (offers) with SKU, barcode, price, purchase price, quantity in stock and quantity in reserve. Filter by variant id, product id or SKU; include=product adds the parent product.

is_archived.description: true for archived variants only, false for active ones.

include.description: product to add the parent product.

limit.description: Variants per page, up to 50. Default 50.

tools.name: keycrm_list_stocks
tools.description: List stock levels per product variant (quantity and reserve), optionally split by warehouse with details=true. Filter by variant id or SKU.

details.description: true to return the stock of each warehouse separately.

limit.description: Rows per page, up to 50. Default 50.

tools.name: keycrm_list_pipelines
tools.description: List the sales pipelines (Воронки) of the CRM with their ids. Returns 400 Leads are not enabled when pipelines are switched off in the CRM settings.

limit.description: Pipelines per page, up to 50. Default 50.

tools.name: keycrm_list_pipeline_statuses
tools.description: List the stages (statuses) of one KeyCRM pipeline. Statuses are not shared between pipelines, so read them for the pipeline you work with.

limit.description: Statuses per page, up to 50. Default 50.

tools.name: keycrm_list_pipeline_cards
tools.description: List pipeline cards (leads or deals) filtered by pipeline, stage, source or created/updated date range, with contact, manager and status. Page with page + 1 until next_page_url is null.

created_between.description: Created in this UTC range: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

updated_between.description: Updated in this UTC range, same format as created_between.

include.description: Comma-separated relations to add: contact.client, products, manager, status, payments, custom_fields. Default contact.client,manager,status.

limit.description: Cards per page, up to 50. Default 50.

tools.name: keycrm_get_pipeline_card
tools.description: Get one KeyCRM pipeline card (lead or deal) by id with contact and buyer, products, manager, status, payments and custom fields.

include.description: Comma-separated relations to add: contact.client, products, manager, status, payments, custom_fields.

tools.name: keycrm_create_order
tools.description: Create a new KeyCRM order. Writes real data and creates a new buyer when the contact is unknown: show the user the source, buyer and products and get confirmation first. Each call creates another order, so never retry a successful call.

source_uuid.description: Order number in the source system, if any.

buyer_phone.description: Buyer's phone in international format with +, e.g. +380671234567.

products.description: Order lines. Each item: sku (matches a catalogue variant), name, price (per unit), quantity; optional discount_percent, discount_amount, comment.

sku.description: Variant SKU, links the line to the catalogue.

ordered_at.description: Order time in UTC, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. Defaults to now.
